name: displayDevice
meaning: Selected render device name (strncpy 15 of the combo text + NUL). Matched back with CB_SELECTSTRING (case-insensitive prefix).

name: displayMode
meaning: First 15 characters of the D3DApp_GetModeString label, e.g. '1024 x 768 x 16'. Passed to Launcher_FillModeCombo as the preselect prefix.

name: soundDevice
meaning: Selected DirectSound device description, 15 chars + NUL.

name: controller
meaning: Selected controller combo text: 'Keyboard only' (localized) or a joystick instance name, 15 chars + NUL.

name: displayModeIndex
meaning: True D3DApp mode ordinal (CB_GETITEMDATA) written by the Accept handler (0x40340f). Never read back; the load path re-derives the mode from displayMode.

name: unused
meaning: Never written or read; zero padding to the 0x50-byte registry value.
